In [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L187), when `build` constructs a `change_of_mind` truth whose initial `schedule["works"]` has only one slot, `t["schedule"]["works"][1:]` is empty and `new_works` falls back to `rng.sample(cand, 1)`. The candidate list `cand` only excludes `dropped` and does not filter out slots already excluded by `t["schedule"]["hard_limits"]` (for example, `change_of_mind:shakedown:0` picks `08:30` despite `hard_limits` containing `"not before 10"`).

Because [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py) is frozen instrument code listed in [phase3-freeze.json](file:///work/docs/phase3-freeze.json#L8), this is a `fix`.

Updated `build` in [clinicbench/truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L184) for `change_of_mind` truths so that the fallback candidate list `cand` excludes slots listed in `t["schedule"]["hard_limits"]` (`excluded = {s for lim in t["schedule"]["hard_limits"] for s in lim["excludes"]}`), and guards `rng.sample(cand, 1)` when `cand` is empty.

### Verification
